title: Theo and the Witness Anew
author: Juniper Reyes
blurb: Isandro Blackwood, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
